'''''Lampranthus falcatus''''', commonly known as the '''sickle brightfig''', is a succulent belonging to the genus ''[[Lampranthus]]''.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Lampranthus falcatus (L.) N.E.Br.|url=http://redlist.sanbi.org/species.php?species=88-77|work=SANBI Redlist}}</ref> The species is endemic to the [[Western Cape]] and forms part of the [[fynbos]]. It occurs from [[Tulbagh]] to [[Worcester, South Africa|Worcester]] and the [[Langeberg]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Lampranthus falcatus (L.) N.E.Br.|url=https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:362216-1|work=Plants of the World Online}}</ref>
